metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the precept, the fourteenth head, and Alse's question at the door.

yesterday: Master Thwaite read the precept against blue starch and preached it. The glass was turned twice. He said fourteenthly.
The Mayor sat ten yards off in a white ruff. A draper's wife in the north aisle was blue at the band.
Alse's band was white. She asked who decides where a permitted shade ends.
Mistress Ansell called it sound doctrine. You counted fourteen parts. She said you had heard a sermon to the end.
The garden is still on the draft. Tomorrow the Theatre plays Errors at two, and you are in it.
